name: Postmark Developer Free
free_limit: Hosted transactional email Developer plan with 100 emails per month, recurring indefinitely; supports API and SMTP sending and development/integration testing. Monthly unused sends do not roll over.
watch_out: Free Developer plan is intended for integration testing and low-volume side projects; no overages allowed, so sending beyond 100 emails/month requires a paid upgrade. Free is not the same as a time-limited paid-plan trial. Paid plans start at $15/month and charge extra sends. Sender/domain approval and acceptable-use policies apply; verify suitability for production marketing before use.
